rules: One entry per testnet run. A result applies to the commit the run used. Only what the run observed against the exchange or the live UI is recorded; code-read findings are not results. Later runs supersede earlier ones for the same requirement. Results: PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED. Each run states follower_network (testnet or mainnet). A requirement with proof_network MAINNET (price quality, slippage, markets absent on testnet) reaches PASS only from a mainnet-follower run; a testnet PASS on it shows as NEEDS_MAINNET.

runs.summary: Read-only start; no order sent. Engine could not finish one cycle on testnet (268 perp DEXes read one by one).

results.evidence: B1: per-DEX sequential reads (~0.52 s each across 268 DEXes); one --once cycle did not finish in 120 s (once_fh.txt).
B1: allMids refresh across all DEXes took ~140 s, so every mid was older than the 5 s bound and every entry unpriceable.
GET /api/global-controls showed the exact configured limits and networks leader mainnet / follower testnet.

U1-U3: front page showed USER equity +$100.00 (account $1,450.12), TRACKED WALLETS (0) with 4 leaders LIVE, and Current: PROPORTIONAL with all wallets fixed.

runs.summary: Started with the mainnet agent key; the first testnet order was refused because that signer does not exist on testnet. Stopped after 17 s.

results.evidence: 15:30:10 first order (MANTA BUY $12.02) went to TESTNET; leaders read from mainnet. Network separation held.

F4/F5: no start-up check that the signer is approved on the follower network; the definite rejection 'User or API Wallet ... does not exist' was recorded as ORDER_UNKNOWN / SEND_OUTCOME_REVIEW_REQUIRED instead of a terminal reject.

runs.network: leaders mainnet (10 most active), follower testnet
runs.summary: 25 orders sent and filled on testnet in ~1.5 min, then stopped on an unexplained ledger/exchange mismatch.

results.evidence: All 25 orders on testnet with mainnet leaders.
Mainnet untouched; the 6 Build 4 leftover mainnet orders unchanged.
Every exchange order id matches an engine send attempt; no unknown orders.
No duplicate sends; 2,908 duplicate leader fills blocked before send.
No order over the $50 max-order cap; the cap fired once.
F1: 25 fills on the exchange, 4 in live_fills.csv; 20 positions the engine thought flat.
F1: main loop ran 4 cycles in ~3 min, each budget_exceeded, re-processing thousands of duplicate leader fills; copy-account poll starved.
F2: one send worker at ~3.5 s per order; leader-to-send delay rose from 7 s to 81 s (SLOW_QUEUE_WAIT CRITICAL); no stale-entry cutoff.
F3: 0x7019's short SELL 447 STABLE flattened 0x7717's long on the exchange while the ledger still showed long 447 (before Boss's netting ruling).

runs.summary: 659 sends / 414 filled in the first 18 min with every exchange order id traced to the engine and the ledger matching the exchange within 2-10 s; netting across leaders worked. Then latency ran away (leader->send p50 93-99 min, backlog 99,906), the total/per-asset caps were breached by inherited + resting exposure, exit-recovery fills were not ledgered (~24 persistent mismatches) and disarm let 33 queued orders out.
